description: Work with your Ignition practice: manage clients and their contacts, keep your service library, create draft proposals, and read agreed services, invoices and payments. Start a workflow when a client or proposal is added.

ignition_new_client_trigger.description: Runs for each new client in your Ignition practice, with their name, reference and state. Clients already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.external_id: Your own identifier for the client, if set.
output.name: The client's name.
output.phone: The client's phone number, if set.
output.reference: Ignition's reference for the client, such as CLI-0042.
output.state: The client's state: lead, active, inactive or archived.

ignition_new_proposal_trigger.description: Runs for each new proposal in your Ignition practice, with its name, client and value. Proposals already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.client_name: The name of the client it is for.
output.client_slug: The slug of the client it is for.
output.monthly_recurring_value_cents: Its monthly recurring value, in cents.
output.name: The proposal's name.
output.reference_number: Ignition's reference for the proposal, such as PROP-0007.
output.state: The proposal's state, normally draft when it is new.
